reviewer: Codex integration review, independent of icon implementation
evidenceInspected: npm run verify built-PWA manifest and icon-dimension checks
observations: The icon uses the same complete CVC symbol as Home, on a white field, with HELPER in the project's CVC blue below it.
At 48 px the symbol remains recognizable and HELPER remains present; the 180/192/512 px variants keep balanced margins.
The circular mask preview clips neither the symbol nor HELPER; the white field maintains the intended launcher appearance.
The built PWA checker confirms the manifest icons are 192 and 512 px and the Apple touch icon is 180 px.
